scenario: An investigative journalist receives a leaked internal government document as a PDF from an anonymous whistleblower. To protect the source's identity, the journalist first uses remove-metadata-from-pdf to strip all identifying metadata (author, creation software, timestamps) from the document before working with it. The sanitized PDF is then processed by pdf-extract to pull out the plain-text content for editorial review. Finally, reporting generates a structured story brief and editorial package that the team will use to prepare the final published piece.
info_flow: remove-metadata-from-pdf ingests the leaked PDF and strips all embedded metadata to de-identify it → pdf-extract reads the sanitized PDF text content for editorial use → reporting assembles the extracted text into a structured editorial brief saved to workspace/artifacts/.
